content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Pt. MMM Hospital Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Pt. MMM Hospital Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The application process is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview on the specified date, which is 08-09-2026. There is no online application deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 12 vacancies for the Senior Resident posts across various specializations at Pt. Madan Mohan Malaviya Hospital.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree with a PG Degree/Diploma or an equivalent qualification recognized by the Medical Council of India in the concerned specialty.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Resident posts is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per Government of India rules for Persons with Disabilities.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will be paid as per Level-11 of the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC).

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the Pt. MMM Hospital recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a Walk-in Interview. Candidates are required to attend the interview with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the Walk-in Interview for Pt. MMM Hospital Senior Resident posts scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled to be held at Pt. Madan Mohan Malaviya Hospital, New Delhi - 110017.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies (ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, category certificate if applicable), and a duly filled application form if required.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these Senior Resident positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these Senior Resident positions is Ad-hoc.
